edits.old: I used to keep a notebook of harbour sketches.

edits.text: The harbour lanterns still have a hold on me — someone stayed up painting them again last night, and I only minded a little that they aren't mine to keep.

evidence.quote: I stayed up painting the harbour lanterns again last night and Ann asked me for a colour version.
I'm glad the lanterns found someone else to love them too.

edits.reason: The harbour lanterns still hold something for me and the exchange today showed it; keeping it in my own voice keeps the thread alive now that the old note is expiring.

summary: Kept one item: the expiring note about harbour sketches was replaced with today's lantern thread, since staying up painting them again still says something about me. Left the people section empty — only one chat, one voice, and Ann is named rather than speaking, so there's nothing solid enough to write about anyone yet.
